name: Ciel and Flowers
description: Fox Ciel has some flowers: r red flowers, g green flowers and b blue flowers. She wants to use these flowers to make several bouquets. There are 4 types of bouquets: To make a "red bouquet", it needs 3 red flowers. To make a "green bouquet", it needs 3 green flowers. To make a "blue bouquet", it needs 3 blue flowers. To make a "mixing bouquet", it needs 1 red, 1 green and 1 blue flower. Help Fox Ciel to find the maximal number of bouquets she can make.
input_specification: The first line contains three integers r , g and b ( 0 ≤ r , g , b ≤ 10 9 ) — the number of red, green and blue flowers.
output_specification: Print the maximal number of bouquets Fox Ciel can make.
approach_summary: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N using Fermat's Little Theorem (mod 10^9+7 or 998244353). Answer nCr queries in O(1) time per query.
